<script>
let recentSearches = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("recentSearches") || "[]");

// Recent searches functions
function renderRecentSearches() {
  const section = document.getElementById("recentSearchesSection");
  const list = document.getElementById("recentSearchesList");
  list.innerHTML = "";

  if (!recentSearches.length) {
    section.style.display = "none";
    return;
  }
  section.style.display = "block";

  recentSearches.slice(0,3).forEach((item, index) => {
    const li = document.createElement("li");
    li.innerHTML = `<span onclick="selectSuggestion('${item}')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> ${item}</span>
                    <i class="fas fa-times remove" onclick="removeRecentSearch(${index})"></i>`;
    list.appendChild(li);
  });
}

function addRecentSearch(text) {
  recentSearches = recentSearches.filter(item => item !== text);
  recentSearches.unshift(text);
  if (recentSearches.length > 3) recentSearches.pop();
  localStorage.setItem("recentSearches", JSON.stringify(recentSearches));
  renderRecentSearches();
}

function removeRecentSearch(index) {
  recentSearches.splice(index, 1);
  localStorage.setItem("recentSearches", JSON.stringify(recentSearches));
  renderRecentSearches();
}

function checkSearch(form) {
  let input = form.q.value.trim();
  if (!input) return false;
  addRecentSearch(input);
  return true;
}

function showSuggestions() {
  document.getElementById("suggestionsBox").style.display = "block";
}
function hideSuggestions() {
  setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById("suggestionsBox").style.display = "none"; }, 200);
}
function selectSuggestion(text) {
  document.querySelector(".search-box input").value = text;
  document.getElementById("suggestionsBox").style.display = "none";
  addRecentSearch(text);
  document.getElementById("searchForm").submit();
}

// ========================
// Live search with Fuse.js + custom ranking
// ========================
const inputFieldLive = document.querySelector(".search-box input");
const suggestionsBoxLive = document.getElementById("suggestionsBox");

// Highlight matched text
function highlightMatch(text, query) {
  const regex = new RegExp(`(${query})`, "gi");
  return text.replace(regex, `<span style="background-color:yellow;">$1</span>`);
}

// Transliteration map
const transliteration = {
  "physics":"ফিজিক্স","chemistry":"কেমিস্ট্রি","math":"ম্যাথ",
  "biology":"বায়োলজি","english":"ইংরেজি","bangla":"বাংলা",
  "ict":"আইসিটি","varsity":"ভার্সিটি","class":"শ্রেণি",
  "10":"১০ম","9":"৯ম","8":"৮ম","7":"৭ম","6":"৬ষ্ঠ",
  "science":"বিজ্ঞান","arts":"মানবিক","commerce":"ব্যবসায়",
  "business":"ব্যবসা","finance":"ফাইন্যান্স","accounting":"একাউন্টিং",
  "geography":"জিওগ্রাফি","economics":"ইকোনমিক্স","ghore":"ঘরে",
  "preparation":"প্রস্তুতি","final":"শেষ","course":"কোর্স",
  "sobar":"সবার","smp":"শেষ মুহূর্তের প্রস্তুতি","bcs":"বিসিএস",
  "bank":"ব্যাংক","govt":"সরকারি","admission":"এডমিশন"
};

inputFieldLive.addEventListener("input", function() {
  const queryRaw = this.value.trim();
  const queryLower = queryRaw.toLowerCase();

  if (!queryLower) {
    suggestionsBoxLive.innerHTML = `
      <div id="recentSearchesSection" style="display:none;">
        <h4>সাম্প্রতিক অনুসন্ধান</h4>
        <ul id="recentSearchesList"></ul>
      </div>
      <h4>জনপ্রিয় অনুসন্ধান</h4>
      <ul>
        <li onclick="selectSuggestion('HSC 27 PCMB')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> HSC 27 PCMB</li>
        <li onclick="selectSuggestion('HSC 27 BEI')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> HSC 27 BEI</li>
        <li onclick="selectSuggestion('Spoken English')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> Spoken English</li>
        <li onclick="selectSuggestion('HSC 26 BEI 2.0')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> HSC 26 BEI 2.0</li>
        <li onclick="selectSuggestion('Varsity A Unit')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> Varsity A Unit</li>
      </ul>`;
    renderRecentSearches();
    return;
  }

  // Handle HSC batch number if present
  const batchMatch = queryRaw.match(/HSC\s*(\d+)/i);
  let filteredCourses = courses;
  if (batchMatch) {
    const batchNumber = batchMatch[1];
    filteredCourses = courses.filter(c => 
      c.title.toLowerCase().includes(batchNumber) ||
      (c.description && c.description.toLowerCase().includes(batchNumber))
    );
  }

  // Fuse.js search
  const fuse = new Fuse(filteredCourses, { keys:['title','description'], threshold:0.3, ignoreLocation:true, minMatchCharLength:2 });
  const queryVariants = [queryLower];
  for(const key in transliteration) if(queryLower.includes(key)) queryVariants.push(transliteration[key].toLowerCase());

  const resultSet = new Map();
  queryVariants.forEach(qv => {
    const results = fuse.search(qv);
    results.forEach(res => { if(!resultSet.has(res.item)) resultSet.set(res.item, res.score); });
  });

  // Custom ranking
  function rankScore(course) {
    let score = 0;
    const title = course.title.toLowerCase();
    const desc = (course.description || "").toLowerCase();
    if(title === queryLower) score += 100;
    if(title.includes(queryLower)) score += 50;
    queryLower.split(/\s+/).forEach(w=>{
      if(title.includes(w)) score+=10;
      if(desc.includes(w)) score+=5;
    });
    if(title.startsWith(queryLower)) score+=20;
    const freq = ((title.match(new RegExp(queryLower,"g"))||[]).length)+((desc.match(new RegExp(queryLower,"g"))||[]).length);
    score += freq*2;
    return score;
  }

  const finalResults = Array.from(resultSet.entries())
    .map(([course, fuseScore])=>({course, finalScore: rankScore(course) - fuseScore*100}))
    .sort((a,b)=>b.finalScore - a.finalScore)
    .map(e=>e.course);

  if(!finalResults.length){
    suggestionsBoxLive.innerHTML = `<h4>সার্চ ফলাফল</h4><ul><li style="color:#888;">কোনো মিল পাওয়া যায়নি। অন্য Keyword দিয়ে চেষ্টা করুন অথবা মেনু থেকে খুঁজুন।</li></ul>`;
    suggestionsBoxLive.style.display = "block";
    return;
  }

  // Render suggestions
  const html = finalResults.slice(0,5).map(c=>{
    const highlightedTitle = highlightMatch(c.title, queryLower);
    return `<li onclick="window.open('${c.link}', '_blank')">
      <img decoding="async" src="${c.image}" alt="${c.title}">
      <div style="flex:1;">
        <div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#333;line-height:1.2;">${c.title}</div>
        
      </div>
    </li>`;
  }).join('');

  suggestionsBoxLive.innerHTML = `<h4>সার্চ ফলাফল</h4><ul>${html}</ul>`;
  suggestionsBoxLive.style.display = "block";
});

// Initial render
renderRecentSearches();
</script></section>		</aside>

<script>
let recentSearches = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("recentSearches") || "[]");

// Recent searches functions
function renderRecentSearches() {
  const section = document.getElementById("recentSearchesSection");
  const list = document.getElementById("recentSearchesList");
  list.innerHTML = "";

  if (!recentSearches.length) {
    section.style.display = "none";
    return;
  }
  section.style.display = "block";

  recentSearches.slice(0,3).forEach((item, index) => {
    const li = document.createElement("li");
    li.innerHTML = `<span onclick="selectSuggestion('${item}')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> ${item}</span>
                    <i class="fas fa-times remove" onclick="removeRecentSearch(${index})"></i>`;
    list.appendChild(li);
  });
}

function addRecentSearch(text) {
  recentSearches = recentSearches.filter(item => item !== text);
  recentSearches.unshift(text);
  if (recentSearches.length > 3) recentSearches.pop();
  localStorage.setItem("recentSearches", JSON.stringify(recentSearches));
  renderRecentSearches();
}

function removeRecentSearch(index) {
  recentSearches.splice(index, 1);
  localStorage.setItem("recentSearches", JSON.stringify(recentSearches));
  renderRecentSearches();
}

function checkSearch(form) {
  let input = form.q.value.trim();
  if (!input) return false;
  addRecentSearch(input);
  return true;
}

function showSuggestions() {
  document.getElementById("suggestionsBox").style.display = "block";
}
function hideSuggestions() {
  setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById("suggestionsBox").style.display = "none"; }, 200);
}
function selectSuggestion(text) {
  document.querySelector(".search-box input").value = text;
  document.getElementById("suggestionsBox").style.display = "none";
  addRecentSearch(text);
  document.getElementById("searchForm").submit();
}

// ========================
// Live search with Fuse.js + custom ranking
// ========================
const inputFieldLive = document.querySelector(".search-box input");
const suggestionsBoxLive = document.getElementById("suggestionsBox");

// Highlight matched text
function highlightMatch(text, query) {
  const regex = new RegExp(`(${query})`, "gi");
  return text.replace(regex, `<span style="background-color:yellow;">$1</span>`);
}

// Transliteration map
const transliteration = {
  "physics":"ফিজিক্স","chemistry":"কেমিস্ট্রি","math":"ম্যাথ",
  "biology":"বায়োলজি","english":"ইংরেজি","bangla":"বাংলা",
  "ict":"আইসিটি","varsity":"ভার্সিটি","class":"শ্রেণি",
  "10":"১০ম","9":"৯ম","8":"৮ম","7":"৭ম","6":"৬ষ্ঠ",
  "science":"বিজ্ঞান","arts":"মানবিক","commerce":"ব্যবসায়",
  "business":"ব্যবসা","finance":"ফাইন্যান্স","accounting":"একাউন্টিং",
  "geography":"জিওগ্রাফি","economics":"ইকোনমিক্স","ghore":"ঘরে",
  "preparation":"প্রস্তুতি","final":"শেষ","course":"কোর্স",
  "sobar":"সবার","smp":"শেষ মুহূর্তের প্রস্তুতি","bcs":"বিসিএস",
  "bank":"ব্যাংক","govt":"সরকারি","admission":"এডমিশন"
};

inputFieldLive.addEventListener("input", function() {
  const queryRaw = this.value.trim();
  const queryLower = queryRaw.toLowerCase();

  if (!queryLower) {
    suggestionsBoxLive.innerHTML = `
      <div id="recentSearchesSection" style="display:none;">
        <h4>সাম্প্রতিক অনুসন্ধান</h4>
        <ul id="recentSearchesList"></ul>
      </div>
      <h4>জনপ্রিয় অনুসন্ধান</h4>
      <ul>
        <li onclick="selectSuggestion('HSC 27 PCMB')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> HSC 27 PCMB</li>
        <li onclick="selectSuggestion('HSC 27 BEI')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> HSC 27 BEI</li>
        <li onclick="selectSuggestion('Spoken English')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> Spoken English</li>
        <li onclick="selectSuggestion('HSC 26 BEI 2.0')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> HSC 26 BEI 2.0</li>
        <li onclick="selectSuggestion('Varsity A Unit')"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> Varsity A Unit</li>
      </ul>`;
    renderRecentSearches();
    return;
  }

  // Handle HSC batch number if present
  const batchMatch = queryRaw.match(/HSC\s*(\d+)/i);
  let filteredCourses = courses;
  if (batchMatch) {
    const batchNumber = batchMatch[1];
    filteredCourses = courses.filter(c => 
      c.title.toLowerCase().includes(batchNumber) ||
      (c.description && c.description.toLowerCase().includes(batchNumber))
    );
  }

  // Fuse.js search
  const fuse = new Fuse(filteredCourses, { keys:['title','description'], threshold:0.3, ignoreLocation:true, minMatchCharLength:2 });
  const queryVariants = [queryLower];
  for(const key in transliteration) if(queryLower.includes(key)) queryVariants.push(transliteration[key].toLowerCase());

  const resultSet = new Map();
  queryVariants.forEach(qv => {
    const results = fuse.search(qv);
    results.forEach(res => { if(!resultSet.has(res.item)) resultSet.set(res.item, res.score); });
  });

  // Custom ranking
  function rankScore(course) {
    let score = 0;
    const title = course.title.toLowerCase();
    const desc = (course.description || "").toLowerCase();
    if(title === queryLower) score += 100;
    if(title.includes(queryLower)) score += 50;
    queryLower.split(/\s+/).forEach(w=>{
      if(title.includes(w)) score+=10;
      if(desc.includes(w)) score+=5;
    });
    if(title.startsWith(queryLower)) score+=20;
    const freq = ((title.match(new RegExp(queryLower,"g"))||[]).length)+((desc.match(new RegExp(queryLower,"g"))||[]).length);
    score += freq*2;
    return score;
  }

  const finalResults = Array.from(resultSet.entries())
    .map(([course, fuseScore])=>({course, finalScore: rankScore(course) - fuseScore*100}))
    .sort((a,b)=>b.finalScore - a.finalScore)
    .map(e=>e.course);

  if(!finalResults.length){
    suggestionsBoxLive.innerHTML = `<h4>সার্চ ফলাফল</h4><ul><li style="color:#888;">কোনো মিল পাওয়া যায়নি। অন্য Keyword দিয়ে চেষ্টা করুন অথবা মেনু থেকে খুঁজুন।</li></ul>`;
    suggestionsBoxLive.style.display = "block";
    return;
  }

  // Render suggestions
  const html = finalResults.slice(0,5).map(c=>{
    const highlightedTitle = highlightMatch(c.title, queryLower);
    return `<li onclick="window.open('${c.link}', '_blank')">
      <img decoding="async" src="${c.image}" alt="${c.title}">
      <div style="flex:1;">
        <div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#333;line-height:1.2;">${c.title}</div>
        
      </div>
    </li>`;
  }).join('');

  suggestionsBoxLive.innerHTML = `<h4>সার্চ ফলাফল</h4><ul>${html}</ul>`;
  suggestionsBoxLive.style.display = "block";
});

// Initial render
renderRecentSearches();
</script></section>		</aside>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  // --- Bottom Nav Active State Logic ---
  const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
  const links = document.querySelectorAll('.bottom-nav a');

  links.forEach(link => {
    const linkPath = new URL(link.href).pathname;

    if (currentPath === "/" && linkPath === "/") {
      link.classList.add("active");
    } else if (linkPath !== "/" && currentPath.startsWith(linkPath)) {
      link.classList.add("active");
    }
  });

  // --- Elements for WhatsApp Logic ---
  const whatsappTrigger = document.getElementById('whatsappTrigger');
  const whatsappPopup = document.getElementById('whatsappPopup');
  const popupClose = document.getElementById('popupClose');
  const floatingButtons = document.querySelector('.floating-buttons');
  const messageBox = document.querySelector('.message-box');
  
  // --- Elements for Chat Menu Logic ---
  const chatMenuTrigger = document.getElementById('chatMenuTrigger');
  const chatMenuPopup = document.getElementById('chatMenuPopup');
  const chatMenuClose = document.getElementById('chatMenuClose');
  const menuWhatsappTrigger = document.getElementById('menuWhatsappTrigger');

  let chatInput = null;
  let sendBtn = null;
  let placeholderTypingStarted = false;

  // --- Helper Functions ---
  function getGreeting() {
    const hour = new Date().getHours();
    if (hour >= 5 && hour < 12) return "শুভ সকাল 🌤️";
    if (hour >= 12 && hour < 15) return "শুভ অপরাহ্ন ☀️";
    if (hour >= 15 && hour < 18) return "শুভ বিকাল 🌇";
    if (hour >= 18 && hour < 21) return "শুভ সন্ধ্যা 🌆";
    return "শুভ রাত্রি 🌙";
  }

  function updateDateTime() {
    const now = new Date();
    const day = now.getDate().toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const monthNames = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
    const month = monthNames[now.getMonth()];
    const year = now.getFullYear();

    let h = now.getHours();
    let m = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
    let s = now.getSeconds().toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    h = h % 12 || 12;

    const timeElement = document.getElementById('chatTime');
    if (timeElement) {
      timeElement.textContent = `${day} ${month} ${year} ${h}:${m}:${s} ${ampm}`;
    }
  }

  function startPlaceholderTyping() {
    const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
    const placeholderText = "এখানে আপনার মেসেজ লিখুন...";
    let index = 0;
    let forward = true;

    function typePlaceholder() {
      if (!input) return;
      if (forward) {
        input.setAttribute('placeholder', placeholderText.substring(0, index + 1));
        index++;
        if (index === placeholderText.length) {
          forward = false;
          setTimeout(typePlaceholder, 3000);
          return;
        }
      } else {
        input.setAttribute('placeholder', placeholderText.substring(0, index - 1));
        index--;
        if (index === 0) {
          forward = true;
          setTimeout(typePlaceholder, 500);
          return;
        }
      }
      setTimeout(typePlaceholder, 120);
    }
    typePlaceholder();
  }

  function updateGreetingMessage() {
    const greeting = getGreeting();
    if(messageBox) {
      messageBox.innerHTML = `
        ${greeting}<br>
        আসসালামু আলাইকুম। আমাদের হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ সাপোর্টে আপনাকে স্বাগতম! অনুগ্রহ করে জানাবেন, আপনি কোন ক্লাসের শিক্ষার্থী এবং কোন কোর্স সম্পর্কে জানতে চাচ্ছেন?
        <div class="message-time" id="chatTime"></div>
      `;
      updateDateTime();
    }

    chatInput = document.getElementById('chatInput');
    sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');

    if (chatInput && sendBtn) {
      // Reverted Logic: Do not clone/replace nodes. This keeps the input reference valid for placeholder typing.
      
      // Prevent duplicate listeners by checking a data attribute
      if (!chatInput.dataset.listenersAttached) {
         chatInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
          if (chatInput.value.trim().length > 0) {
            sendBtn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-paper-plane"></i>`;
          } else {
            sendBtn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-comment"></i>`;
          }
         });
         chatInput.dataset.listenersAttached = 'true';
      }

      if (!sendBtn.dataset.listenersAttached) {
         sendBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const text = chatInput.value.trim();
          if (text.length === 0) return;

          const phone = '8801814946474';
          const rawPath = window.location.pathname;
          let pagePath = rawPath.replace(/\/$/, "");
          if (pagePath === "" || pagePath === "/") {
            pagePath = "/homepage";
          }

          const message = `${text}\n\n— Message Source: ${pagePath}`;
          const url = `https://wa.me/${phone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`;
          window.open(url, '_blank');

          chatInput.value = '';
          sendBtn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-comment-dots"></i>`;

          messageBox.innerHTML = `
            আমাদের সাথে যোগাযোগ করার জন্য আপনাকে ধন্যবাদ। আমাদের সাপোর্ট টিম খুব দ্রুতই আপনার মেসেজের উত্তর দিবেন ইনশাআল্লাহ। আমরা সবসময় আপনাকে সাহায্য করতে প্রস্তুত এবং আপনার অভিজ্ঞতাটি আরও ভালো করতে চেষ্টা করব। 
            <div class="message-time" id="chatTime"></div>
          `;
          updateDateTime();
        });
        sendBtn.dataset.listenersAttached = 'true';
      }
    }

    if (!placeholderTypingStarted) {
      placeholderTypingStarted = true;
      startPlaceholderTyping();
    }
  }

  // --- Logic: WhatsApp Popup Trigger ---
  function toggleWhatsappPopup() {
    // If Chat Menu is open, close it first
    if (chatMenuPopup.style.display === 'block') {
      chatMenuPopup.style.display = 'none';
    }

    if (whatsappPopup.style.display === 'block') {
      whatsappPopup.style.display = 'none';
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
        floatingButtons.style.display = 'flex';
      }
    } else {
      updateGreetingMessage();
      whatsappPopup.style.display = 'block';
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
        floatingButtons.style.display = 'none';
      }
      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem('whatsappPopupShown', '1');
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  if (whatsappTrigger) {
    whatsappTrigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      toggleWhatsappPopup();
    });
  }

  if (popupClose) {
    popupClose.addEventListener('click', () => {
      whatsappPopup.style.display = 'none';
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
        floatingButtons.style.display = 'flex';
      }
    });
  }
  
  // --- Logic: Chat Menu Trigger ---
  if(chatMenuTrigger && chatMenuPopup) {
    chatMenuTrigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      
      // If Whatsapp popup is open, close it first
      if (whatsappPopup.style.display === 'block') {
         whatsappPopup.style.display = 'none';
      }
      
      if (chatMenuPopup.style.display === 'block') {
        chatMenuPopup.style.display = 'none';
        if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
          floatingButtons.style.display = 'flex';
        }
      } else {
        chatMenuPopup.style.display = 'block';
        if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
          floatingButtons.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }
    });
  }

  if(chatMenuClose) {
    chatMenuClose.addEventListener('click', () => {
       chatMenuPopup.style.display = 'none';
       if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
          floatingButtons.style.display = 'flex';
       }
    });
  }
  
  // --- Logic: "WhatsApp" item inside Chat Menu ---
  if(menuWhatsappTrigger) {
    menuWhatsappTrigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
       e.preventDefault();
       e.stopPropagation();
       // Close the menu
       chatMenuPopup.style.display = 'none';
       // Open the whatsapp popup logic
       toggleWhatsappPopup();
    });
  }

  // --- Global Click listener to close popups ---
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    // Close WhatsApp Popup
    if (whatsappPopup.style.display === 'block' && 
        !whatsappPopup.contains(e.target) && 
        e.target !== whatsappTrigger) {
      whatsappPopup.style.display = 'none';
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
        floatingButtons.style.display = 'flex';
      }
    }
    
    // Close Chat Menu Popup
    if (chatMenuPopup.style.display === 'block' && 
        !chatMenuPopup.contains(e.target) && 
        e.target !== chatMenuTrigger) {
      chatMenuPopup.style.display = 'none';
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
        floatingButtons.style.display = 'flex';
      }
    }
  });

  // --- Auto-Show WhatsApp Popup Logic (Existing) ---
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    let alreadyShown = false;
    try {
      alreadyShown = sessionStorage.getItem('whatsappPopupShown') === '1';
    } catch (e) {
      alreadyShown = false;
    }

    if (!alreadyShown) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        // Do not auto-open if chat menu is already open
        if (whatsappPopup.style.display !== 'block' && chatMenuPopup.style.display !== 'block') {
          updateGreetingMessage();
          whatsappPopup.style.display = 'block';
          if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
            floatingButtons.style.display = 'none';
          }
          try {
            sessionStorage.setItem('whatsappPopupShown', '1');
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      }, 5000);
    }
  });
});
</script>
